title: trust.rs: IID comparison uses non-constant-time equality
description:
Line 102: verify_iid_derivation compares derived_iid == *claimed_iid using standard equality.

While IIDs are derived from public keys (not secret), constant-time comparison is defensive practice. An attacker probing for valid IIDs could theoretically extract timing information about which bytes matched.

Fix: Use subtle::ConstantTimeEq for the comparison:
  use subtle::ConstantTimeEq;
  derived_iid.ct_eq(claimed_iid).into()

Note: subtle is already a dependency of lichen-link.
